precision_objective: Convert the exact geometric DERD harmonic recurrence into a fast falsifiable screen and determine the minimum evidence required before catalog-scale use.

source_basis.role: four-parameter difference-of-radii proposal and normalization boundary

supporting_results: Exact synthetic DERD harmonics pass recurrence, residue, recovery, and forecast tests near floating-point precision.
The catalog adapter preserves an explicit sine-versus-cosine convention rather than silently guessing it.
The uniform-phase observation-count sweep first passes all frozen robustness gates at 160 observations.
contradiction_and_null_results: The 24-point cadence-aware holdout ROC AUC was 0.4764, so the current excerpt cannot validate the screen.
No current real pilot star passed the combined score, SNR, conditioning, and stability gate.
Sixteen of twenty real pilot stars had fewer than four harmonics at SNR >= 3 or otherwise remained evidence-insufficient.
Period-coordinate changes produced large score changes for some sparse stars.
Four-harmonic feature catalogs cannot supply the default higher-harmonic forecast test.
The exact phase convention of discovered third-party feature tables has not yet been byte-frozen and independently verified.
physical_claim_boundary: Harmonic compatibility cannot identify internal Kepler motion, transparent shells, absolute mass, or shell mass.
